author: Bobby Grayson
description: No file under Leanactors/ was touched on wf7/control: SysProps.lean, Fair.lean and AssocList.lean are unchanged, and the ten committed Gen files regenerate byte for byte. The generated Lean the new expression compiler emits uses only what was already there -- Lean's own if/then/else, match, let, min/max, Int.natAbs, List membership -- plus AssocList for maps. Siblings have nothing to reuse or clash with from this branch on the Lean side; the only shared files are elixir/to_lean.exs, elixir/readiness.exs and elixir/test.
title: wf7/control added no generic Lean lemmas
